query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS social_posts (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  userId INT NOT NULL,
  content TEXT NOT NULL,
  mediaUrl VARCHAR(1000),
  mediaType ENUM('image','video','audio','none') DEFAULT 'none',
  hashtags VARCHAR(500),
  postType ENUM('text','music_preview','announcement','track_release','event') DEFAULT 'text',
  likeCount INT DEFAULT 0,
  repostCount INT DEFAULT 0,
  commentCount INT DEFAULT 0,
  saveCount INT DEFAULT 0,
  createdAt BIGINT NOT NULL,
  updatedAt BIGINT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS social_post_likes (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  postId INT NOT NULL,
  userId INT NOT NULL,
  createdAt BIGINT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE KEY unique_post_like (postId, userId)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS social_post_reposts (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  postId INT NOT NULL,
  userId INT NOT NULL,
  createdAt BIGINT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE KEY unique_post_repost (postId, userId)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS social_post_saves (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  postId INT NOT NULL,
  userId INT NOT NULL,
  createdAt BIGINT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE KEY unique_post_save (postId, userId)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS social_comments (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  postId INT NOT NULL,
  userId INT NOT NULL,
  content TEXT NOT NULL,
  createdAt BIGINT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS drop_radar (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  userId INT NOT NULL,
  title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  artist VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  previewUrl VARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL,
  coverUrl VARCHAR(1000),
  genre VARCHAR(100),
  description TEXT,
  fireCount INT DEFAULT 0,
  isTrending TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 0,
  createdAt BIGINT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS drop_votes (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  dropId INT NOT NULL,
  userId INT NOT NULL,
  createdAt BIGINT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE KEY unique_drop_vote (dropId, userId)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS dj_battles (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  dj1Id INT NOT NULL,
  dj2Id INT NOT NULL,
  dj1TrackUrl VARCHAR(1000),
  dj2TrackUrl VARCHAR(1000),
  dj1TrackTitle VARCHAR(255),
  dj2TrackTitle VARCHAR(255),
  dj1Votes INT DEFAULT 0,
  dj2Votes INT DEFAULT 0,
  status ENUM('active','ended') DEFAULT 'active',
  winnerId INT,
  endsAt BIGINT,
  createdAt BIGINT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS battle_votes (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  battleId INT NOT NULL,
  userId INT NOT NULL,
  votedForDjId INT NOT NULL,
  createdAt BIGINT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE KEY unique_battle_vote (battleId, userId)
);
